claim_evidence.beat: The 2024 film expands the original 1986 concept into a "time-shifting supernatural freak fest."
Director Chuck Russell aimed to update the film, expanding its world and giving the scary premise a fresh, modern spin.
The story unfolds across two distinct yet interconnected timelines, with one revealing the board's origin.
Unlike the original's Ouija board, this film features a pendulum board and introduces witches, including the Queen of Witches, Naga Soth.
Pendulum boards are centuries older than Ouija boards and were outlawed in the 1700s, with their use potentially leading to being burned at the stake.
